cases.query: Invites work for alice@example.com, but the same flow rejects alice+demo@example.com with 403. Follow both requests far enough to prove where they diverge, then report what causes it; don't patch it yet.
Before we change the invitation module, assess it as it stands across correctness, security, and maintainability, rank the risks you find, and produce a report without fixing anything.

A candidate build is available at http://localhost:4173. Go through account creation, recovery, and deletion the way a customer would, including expired links and back-button use, and list only problems you can repeat.
